value.rationale: The exact full Fourier nullity and sharp endpoint projection norm are motivated recoverability and amplification invariants of the classical noncrossing-tree ensemble. At seven labelled vertices the first unexpected post-square cancellation appears after the five- and six-vertex odd-count zero-free cases; all 14 minimum two-chord zeros form a single dihedral symmetry orbit. This supplies a natural, complete finite spectral benchmark not implied by known tree counts or degree refinements. Larger polygons remain open.
